svg.aria-label: Asset servicing — subsystems and the experience layer
svg.title: Asset servicing — subsystems and the experience layer
svg.text: Asset servicing — subsystems and the experience layer
A subsystem is a perimeter: Reference and Custody each hold their data and expose their service

g.text: What a client sees of what they hold.
Where an advisor acts on a client’s behalf.
Assembles one client view from the four subsystems. Keeps nothing.
Statements and regulatory extracts, built on request.
The one place a static datum is written.
Marks and valuations, intraday and at close.
Every mark ever published, kept for audit.
Dividends, splits and mergers as announced.
The notices as received, never rewritten.
The one place a holding is written.
